Perfect! Black wins the knight (+3 material). The main line is: **Qa1+ Kc2 Qa4+ Kc1 Qxc6** gaining a knight.

**Best move:** Qa1+

**Main line:** Qa1+ Kc2 Qa4+ Kc1 Qxc6

**Motif:** Attraction (the checks pull the White king away from defending the knight)

**Coaching note:**

When your opponent plays a knight move, check if it can be driven away with checks. Here, Qa1+ forces the king to c2, then Qa4+ is another check that leaves the knight on c6 undefended. Even though you give two checks, you win the piece—checks often gain time to capture an undefended target. Look for this pattern: move into a square where it can be attacked, then use forcing moves to prevent its defense.
